# onetsolutions_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH public key of a project, to install on new instances.

A key cannot be changed: changing any argument replaces it. Deleting a key does not remove it from
the instances it was installed on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onetsolutions_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the key, unique in the project.
- `public_key` (String) The public key in OpenSSH format (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment`). Surrounding whitespace, such as the trailing newline `file()` reads, is ignored. After an import the state holds the key trimmed: a configuration with a trailing newline then plans one in-place update that changes nothing.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `project_id` (String) The project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the key was registered (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) The SHA256 fingerprint of the key, as `ssh-keygen -l` prints it.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the SSH key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = onetsolutions_ssh_key.laptop
  id = "3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<project_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id and project_id.
terraform import onetsolutions_ssh_key.laptop 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f
```
